positioning.en: Run several DeepSeek Harness sessions side by side, hand work from one to another, and watch the whole collaboration on one read-only canvas.
positioning.zh: 并排运行多个 DeepSeek Harness 会话，让它们互相交接任务，并在同一张只读看板上看清整场协作。

packageDescription: Multi-session collaboration for DeepSeek Harness: peer session calls, a shared blackboard, and a read-only topology canvas.
